_comment: Weight training bakes a person's messages into model weights, and weights cannot forget one person later. training/train_lora.py therefore refuses unless the person's record here says status=granted, scope includes weights_training, and granted_by / evidence / date are filled in. Only edit a record after the PERSON THEMSELVES has agreed (evidence: where that agreement can be checked, e.g. a dated message link or note). Revoking: run python -m training.revoke --person <id>.
